Description: Mar Structural Design couples creativity and cutting-edge technical skills to design innovative structures. It is the leveraging of design with state-of-the-art analysis that differentiates Mar Structural Design in the engineering market, thus opening new opportunities for invention, architectural expression and high-performance. The firm’s project types are varied, but the focus is on unique and challenging projects. Areas of specialization include seismically resilient designs, sustainable designs, solar support systems, modular construction, and buildings with expressed structure. The firm advocates early collaboration with architects and contractors to provide clients with the most cost-efficient design solutions possible. Moreover, this focus on high-performance seismic and sustainable design has positioned Mar Structural Design at the forefront of the green-building movement. The firm’s enthusiasm for innovation has fueled the expansion of its design repertoire from traditional steel, concrete, and wood construction to such materials as rammed earth, bamboo, straw bale, timber frame, and structural insulated panels.
